item.title: Securing your CaaS using Google's gVisor
item.description: TL;DR — A standard Linux container is an isolation boundary, not a security boundary. Every container on a host shares one kernel, so a single kernel exploit can compromise the whole node. gVisor inserts a user-space kernel (runsc) between your container and the host, dramatically shrinking the attack surface. It’s now production-grade — Google runs Cloud Run, App Engine and Cloud Functions on it — and integrates cleanly with containerd and Kubernetes via RuntimeClass.
